next.reason: 1985: a non-common, non-separately-compiled program may be called 'if, and only if, that program is directly contained within the calling program'. 2023: its name 'may be referenced only by statements included in that containing program or, if the program possesses the recursive attribute, in the program itself' (§2023:8.4.6.3 SR1), applied to CALL by §2023:14.9.4.4 GR3. The added self-reference needs the recursive attribute, attained only 'by specifying the RECURSIVE clause' (§2023:8.6.6), which no 1985 program contains; for 1985 source the rule accepts and refuses the same calls.
